items.summary: Nvidia's market cap hit $5.5 trillion with $45B+ AI supply chain investments in 2026, while TSMC's Q2 revenue forecast surged on AI demand and the company approved a $31.3B capital budget. Applied Materials reported record Q2 revenue of $7.91B with 50% gross margins as AI buildout drives semiconductor complexity.

news.title: Nvidia's market capitalization reached record $5.5 trillion amid $45B AI supply chain investments
Lam Research reports Q1 FY26 revenue of $5.84B with 50% gross margins, guidance $6.6B for next quarter

items.summary: Department of Energy awarded $94 million to accelerate SMR deployments; GE Vernova and Hitachi entered MOU for BWRX-300 reactor commercialization in Southeast Asia. US received 1.7 metric tons of HALEU from Japan, the largest international shipment in NNSA history, to support advanced reactor fuel supply.

news.title: DOE Awards $94 Million to Accelerate Small Modular Reactor Deployments
GE Vernova and Hitachi enter MOU for BWRX-300 small modular reactor deployment in Southeast Asia

items.summary: Trump administration released 2026 National Defense Strategy with $150B additional DOD funding and $6B for national security. Strategic focus shifted to hemispheric security with emphasis on munitions, shipbuilding, and emerging technologies amid Iran conflict and geopolitical tensions.

news.title: 2026 National Defense Strategy allocates additional $150 billion to DOD with focus on shipbuilding and munitions
Iran-UAE tensions escalate with drone strike on Barakah nuclear facility; Israel deploys troops and missile defenses to UAE

items.summary: Bain & Co. identified $100B US market opportunity for SaaS from agentic AI's cross-system coordination abilities. SAP announced autonomous enterprise suite with 200+ agents launching in months; fewer than 10% of enterprises have scaled agents to real production value as of May 2026.

news.title: Bain & Company identifies $100 billion SaaS market opportunity from agentic AI automation
SAP launches Autonomous Suite with 200+ agents and 50+ assistants for autonomous enterprise

items.summary: Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly own nearly 100% of GLP-1 citations in AI tools where Americans research weight loss; GLP-1 ranked #1 health trend for 2026 by U.S. News & World Report. CMS launched BALANCE Model to expand GLP-1 access in Medicaid and Medicare with Medicare demonstration starting July 2026.

news.title: Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly control nearly 100% of GLP-1 citations in AI research tools as of May 2026
CMS launches BALANCE Model to expand GLP-1 access in Medicaid and Medicare starting July 2026

items.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated Atlas lifting 100+ pound appliances using AI-driven whole-body control; Japan Airlines deployed humanoids at Haneda Airport for three-year operational commitment. EgoScale paper in February showed robotics foundation models follow same scaling laws as LLMs, attracting $6B to world model companies in Q1 2026.

news.title: Boston Dynamics releases Atlas humanoid footage lifting heavy appliances using reinforcement learning and advanced simulation
Japan Airlines deploys humanoid robots at Tokyo Haneda Airport for three-year operational commitment

items.summary: Copper prices surged above $14,000 per metric ton in January 2026 before moderating to $13,000/mt by mid-May amid Iran conflict concerns. BloombergNEF warns copper may enter structural deficit as early as 2026; supply disruptions in Chile, Indonesia, and Peru compound tight market conditions. LME copper trading at $14,140/mt as of May 2026.

news.title: Copper prices reach record highs exceeding $14,500 per metric ton in January 2026 amid AI and electrification demand
BloombergNEF warns copper may enter structural deficit as early as 2026 with supply constraints from Chile, Indonesia, Peru

items.summary: Asia-Pacific sovereign AI infrastructure market estimated at $9-14 billion in 2026, projected to reach $23-47 billion by 2030 at 27-35% CAGR. Canada and TELUS advanced work on sovereign AI data centre project in British Columbia; NTT DATA reported 35% of CAIOs identify sovereign AI as biggest adoption barrier due to infrastructure requirements.

news.title: Asia-Pacific sovereign AI infrastructure market estimated at $13 billion in 2026, growing to $23-47 billion by 2030
Government of Canada and TELUS advance sovereign AI data centre initiative in British Columbia
